tasks.short: Consult and advise professionals on medical applications of sciences.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual scientific evidence and consultation context for medical application questions
inputs: actual professional question and application context
actual scientific sources and relevant study records

steps.what: Consult with and advise actual professionals on scientific applications, limitations and implications
inputs: checked applicable consultation evidence
actual physician/educator/researcher/official questions and constraints
outputs: actual chosen scientific advice and limitations

steps.what: Record and check final actual written advice using verified source and question fields
inputs: actual chosen scientific advice and limitations
checked applicable consultation evidence
outputs: checked final actual written advice and permitted recipient/destination

steps.what: Save checked final actual scientific consultation advice
inputs: checked final actual written advice and permitted recipient/destination

steps.what: Deliver exact checked written advice to actual authorised consulting professional
inputs: checked final actual written advice and permitted recipient/destination

tasks.design: Configure native consultation/source links in {DOCS} and {DATA_PLATFORM}, with repeated question/source fields in the advice record. Retain scientific advice and full new-meaning capture/check before separate save and actual delivery through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Consultations may repeat source navigation and stable question/source entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and record fields can reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate scientific applications and limitations need professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The epidemiologist recognises when evidence does not support the requested medical application.
tasks.altitude: Less advice administration; scientific judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native question/source links and record fields can assist scientific consultation; they do not determine medical applications or clinical advice.

assumptions: Actual enquirer supplies context and actual publishers/study owners supply evidence; epidemiologist verifies sources and retains all scientific reading, reasoning and conversation. No professional decision is automated.

S3 cuts repeated identifiers/citation fields only; new advice and full scientific/omission review remain. Written advice is included where actual; oral-only advice removes unused record/delivery branches and reweights rather than excluding actual written work.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native functions first; existing links/prefill earn zero saving. Save/send each retain one percent using existing checks. External delivery only to actual authorised recipient; internal recipient uses internal delivery authority.
unknowns: Which written advice fields and lookup repeat?
research_questions: Can native fields reduce administration after complete scientific checking?

incremental.description: Maintain actual consultation/source links and record fields.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual written advice and exact record destination; edits require recheck
s3 exact final actual advice, disclosure scope and authorised recipient; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 lookup + 13*0.20 repeated fields = 8.6; minus 0.5 upkeep = 8.1. Half eligible gives 4.3 minus 0.5 = 3.8. Actual advice, new meaning, complete checking and save/delivery retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise professional, technical and clerical personnel.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual staff assignments, project status and supervision requirements
inputs: actual staff assignments and role requirements
actual owner-updated project/work status

steps.what: Supervise actual professional, technical and clerical personnel and address work and support needs
inputs: checked actual personnel supervision context
actual staff work, observations and concerns
outputs: actual supervision decisions and agreed support/actions

steps.what: Record and check actual assigned supervision actions or personnel notes where required
inputs: actual supervision decisions and agreed support/actions
outputs: checked final actual supervision record and restricted destination

steps.what: Save checked actual personnel or project supervision record
inputs: checked final actual supervision record and restricted destination

tasks.design: Configure native assignment/status links in {PROJECT}, {HCM} and {DOCS}. Retain actual supervision and new action/note capture/check, with a separate save to the actual project or restricted personnel destination.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision preparation can repeat assignment/status navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work/status views can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: People's needs, fair assessment and support require actual interaction.
tasks.human_edge: The epidemiologist recognises when a work problem requires support rather than a performance inference.
tasks.altitude: Less supervision lookup; personnel judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native assignment/status views can support supervision preparation; they do not assess personnel or infer performance.

assumptions: Actual staff/project owners produce status updates; epidemiologist checks freshness in s1 and retains all actual observation and discussion. Missing status requires actual clarification, not guessed completion.

S3 retains new action/note capture and full checking. Actual record only where required; no mandatory report per conversation. Project and personnel destinations are alternatives with appropriate access. Actual written notices, if required, are separate final-content gated sends with no avoided labour claimed.
Shares are provisional, not measured. Native views first; existing status access earns zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing checking; no staff labour saving included.
research_questions: Can native views reduce preparation without inferring staff performance?

incremental.description: Maintain actual assignment/status links and access.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual supervision record and exact permitted project/personnel destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 navigation = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Supervision, actual capture/check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach medicine principles and medical/laboratory procedures.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual approved medicine/procedure teaching sources and learner requirements
inputs: actual teaching topic and learner group
actual approved medical/laboratory teaching sources
outputs: checked actual teaching context and chosen source material

steps.what: Teach actual medicine principles and demonstrate medical/laboratory procedures to learners
inputs: checked actual teaching context and chosen source material
actual learners, questions and demonstration equipment

steps.what: Assess actual learner understanding and safe procedure practice and provide feedback
inputs: actual teaching and learner practice
actual learner responses and observed technique
outputs: actual assessed learning and chosen feedback

steps.what: Record and check actual required attendance, assessment and feedback after teaching
inputs: actual assessed learning and chosen feedback
actual attendance evidence

steps.what: Save checked actual medical/procedure teaching and assessment record
inputs: checked final actual teaching/assessment record

tasks.design: Configure native course-to-approved-source links in {LMS} and {DOCS}. Retain actual teaching preparation choices, demonstrations and learner assessment, then capture/check required outcomes before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching preparation can repeat approved-source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native course/source links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Medical understanding and safe technique must be observed and taught.
tasks.human_edge: The epidemiologist notices a dangerous misunderstanding during actual learner practice.
tasks.altitude: Less source lookup; medical teaching stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course/source links can support preparation; they do not teach or establish learner competence.

assumptions: Actual teaching/procedure owners supply approved sources; epidemiologist checks applicability and retains substantive preparation. Actual learners produce responses; teacher observes attendance and competence only after actual activity.

S4 retains all actual required record capture and full checking. No completion inferred from enrolment. Record only where required; remove unused branch and reweight. Actual material distribution/assessment notices are separately final-content gated sends with no avoided labour claimed.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Source setup counted once per actual revised session, not per learner. Native links first; existing access earns zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing checking.
research_questions: Can native links reduce preparation while preserving actual teaching and assessment?

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual attendance/assessment record and exact learner/session destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 navigation = 6; minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Half eligible gives 3 minus 0.5 = 2.5. Actual teaching, assessment, outcome capture/check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and analyse samples for effects on cells and tissue.

steps.what: Prepare actual samples and record identity, condition and approved experimental setup
inputs: actual cell/tissue samples
actual approved experimental methods
outputs: actual prepared identified samples and primary setup observations

steps.what: Perform actual study exposures to drugs, gases, pesticides or microorganisms using approved methods
inputs: actual prepared identified samples and primary setup observations
actual controlled study substances and equipment
outputs: actual exposed samples and captured exposure conditions

steps.what: Analyse actual samples and interpret effects on cell structure and tissue
inputs: actual exposed samples and captured exposure conditions
actual controls, measurements and sample observations
outputs: actual captured sample results and chosen effect interpretation

steps.what: Record and check actual sample-study results using verified sample and protocol fields
inputs: actual captured sample results and chosen effect interpretation
actual prepared identified samples and primary setup observations
actual exposed samples and captured exposure conditions
outputs: checked final actual cell/tissue study record

steps.what: Commit checked final actual sample-analysis record
inputs: checked final actual cell/tissue study record

tasks.design: Configure repeated sample/protocol fields in the laboratory module of {OPS_SYSTEM}. Retain all actual preparation, exposure, measurement and interpretation using {DATA_PLATFORM} where already employed, with complete new-result capture/check before a separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sample records can repeat verified sample and protocol identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native laboratory fields can reduce repeated identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Actual experimental conditions, tissue effects and causal interpretation need scientific work.
tasks.human_edge: The epidemiologist recognises an artefact or control failure that invalidates an apparent effect.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated sample entry; laboratory science stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native sample/protocol fields can assist laboratory records; they do not prepare samples, expose tissue or establish biological effects.

assumptions: Actual protocol owner supplies approved method; retained s1/s2/s3 produce all sample identities, conditions, measurements and observations. No structured result is assumed without its actual instrument/scientist producer.

S4 reduces stable sample/protocol identifiers only; all new results, uncertainty and full scientific/source checking remain. No instrument import or automated image analysis is assumed; if actual duplicate transcription exists, split and measure it separately. Actual laboratory time and existing instrument runtime earn zero saving.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native fields first; existing prefill earns zero new saving. Commit retains one percent using existing checking. Actual findings release requires its own final-version gated send with no avoided labour claimed.
research_questions: Can native fields reduce identifiers after full sample/result checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual sample/protocol fields and version checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual sample-study record and exact sample/protocol destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 14*0.20 repeated identifiers = 2.8; minus 1 upkeep = 1.8. Half eligible gives 1.4 minus 1 = 0.4. All laboratory work, new results capture, complete checks and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Epidemiologists retain scientific advice, teaching and experiments while actual source retrieval and repeated identifiers may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Measure actual repeated administration without inferring outcomes or reducing scientific and interpersonal work.
